Build understanding. One System at a time.

Model, connect, and explore cyber-physical systems.
Keep every experiment connected to its evidence.

FIXTURE Process control reference Explore a normalized process response, tune the setpoint and compare measured reference observations. Guided example owned_reference Scope limit: Owned executable reference only; external CARLA, native X-COM, process equipment and physical devices are not integrated.

FIXTURE Automotive reference Explore a normalized controller and plant response using the same reference model; no vehicle dynamics claim. Guided example owned_reference Scope limit: Owned executable reference only; external CARLA, native X-COM, process equipment and physical devices are not integrated.

FIXTURE Process control feedback reference Declare the reference loop's unit-delay feedback explicitly and observe the state through an explicit linear converter to percent. Guided example owned_reference Scope limit: Owned executable reference only; external CARLA, native X-COM, process equipment and physical devices are not integrated.

PROTOTYPE Autoverse complete demo Load the real CARLA, VCU, SOME/IP, S-CORE and Android topology with the original Pygame manual-control window. Guided example external_demo Scope limit: Loading the declaration starts nothing. Native Autoverse provider installation and readiness are required.

PROTOTYPE Autoverse with X-Verse platform Run the complete simulation with Maestro component phases, native X-COM forwarding and original Argus evidence. Guided example platform_simulation Scope limit: Requires explicit enrollment of the existing Linux simulation installation and verified native bridge.

PROTOTYPE Autoverse recorded-fault assessments Author browser-input losses, run the complete stack, and assess recorded bridge-lease acknowledgements with explicit host clock and event coverage. Guided example external_demo Scope limit: Loading the declaration starts nothing. Native Autoverse provider installation and readiness are required.

FIXTURE Live target reference Change the owned model target during a run and inspect its recorded old/new values while the initial configuration stays frozen. Guided example owned_reference Scope limit: Owned executable reference only; external CARLA, native X-COM, process equipment and physical devices are not integrated.
Reference runs verify Studio workflows. Their results do not establish external simulator or physical-device integration.
